description: Angular component for configuring LWM2M device server settings, including form validation, security modes, and interaction with device profile service.

classes.name: Lwm2mDeviceConfigServerComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing LWM2M device configuration server settings, including form controls, validation, and security configuration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group, sets up value change subscriptions, and manages security mode updates.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form with provided server data and fetches security info if needed.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating form value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: updateValidate
methods.description: Adjusts validators based on selected security mode.

methods.name: setValidators
methods.description: Adds required validator to serverPublicKey control.

methods.name: propagateChangeState
methods.description: Calls registered change callback with current form value.

methods.name: getLwm2mBootstrapSecurityInfo
methods.description: Fetches security info from device profile service based on security type.

methods.name: changeSecurityHostPortFields
methods.description: Copies security host and port to main host and port fields.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns errors if invalid.
